development.temporalReviewBatchInterpretation: Batch differences can reflect reviewer drift and adaptive case selection; they are not population or source cohorts.

variants.name: positive-structural
variants.description: V2 absolute structural evidence plus candidate-independent v3 field ownership.

variants.name: owned-structural
variants.description: Candidate-independent distribution continuity with ownership-gated raw progression and connectivity.

variants.name: role-spatial
variants.description: Separates candidate-independent surface-role and spatial ownership alongside v2 structural evidence.

variants.name: legacy-proxy-benchmark
variants.description: Diagnostic D/connected/role proxy using candidate-dependent legacy surface field ownership; never selectable.

variants.name: owned-all
variants.description: E: unified field ownership gates distribution continuity, raw progression, and raw connectivity.

variants.name: separate-owned-modes
variants.description: F: separate surface-role and spatial geometric-mean continuity modes plus owned progression and connectivity.

variants.name: unified-owned-continuity
variants.description: G: soft-OR of surface-role and spatial geometric-mean continuity plus owned progression and connectivity.

variants.name: unified-only
variants.description: H: unified surface-role/spatial owned continuity alone.

standardization.leakageControl: means and scales are computed separately inside each training fold

objective.classWeights: each observed class has total weight 0.5

optimizer.stepSize: reciprocal of a weighted Frobenius upper bound on the logistic-plus-L2 Hessian

thresholdSelection.candidateThresholds: 0, 1, and midpoints between consecutive unique training scores

variantSelection.eligibleVariants: shippable variants A-C and E-H only; diagnostic variant D is never selectable
variantSelection.failureBehavior: model is null when no shippable variant meets the pooled sensitivity requirement

rule.eligibleVariants: shippable variants A-C and E-H only; diagnostic variant D is never selectable
rule.failureBehavior: model is null when no shippable variant meets the pooled sensitivity requirement

variantSelection.outcome: Selected by the predeclared pooled leave-temporal-batch-out ordering.

definition.name: positive-structural
definition.description: V2 absolute structural evidence plus candidate-independent v3 field ownership.

conditionalFeatureDiagnostics.interpretation: Positive loss deltas and negative AUC deltas indicate unique conditional value after refitting all remaining features.

leaveOneTemporalReviewBatchOut.interpretation: Temporal review batches are held out as robustness checks only; no batch-specific threshold is used by the final model.
